name: Puerto Rican parrot
desc: Critically endangered. Eats flowers, fruit, leaves and bark, and nests in tree cavities, favouring palo colorado trees. Hurricanes have repeatedly cut its numbers.
about: The Puerto Rican amazon, also known as the Puerto Rican parrot (Spanish: cotorra puertorriqueña) or iguaca (Taíno), is the only extant parrot endemic to Puerto Rico.
